phrase: Could you give me a quick update?
japanese_meaning: 簡単に進捗を教えてもらえますか
example: Could you give me a quick update before lunch?
notes: Polite and flexible for work or daily requests.
contrast: Can you...より丁寧で柔らかい。

prompts.situation: You want a quick status update from a coworker.
prompts.cloze: Could you give me a quick ___?

support.jaHint: 簡単に進捗を教えてもらえますか

phrase: Would it be possible to move this to Friday?
japanese_meaning: これを金曜に移すことは可能でしょうか
pattern: Would it be possible to + verb...?
example: Would it be possible to move this to Friday due to a conflict?
notes: A formal way to request schedule changes.
contrast: Could we...より距離感がありフォーマル。

prompts.situation: You want to ask if moving the meeting is possible.
prompts.cloze: Would it be possible to ___ this to Friday?

support.jaHint: これを金曜に移すことは可能でしょうか

phrase: I won't be able to make it this time.
japanese_meaning: 今回は参加できなさそうです
pattern: I won't be able to + verb
example: Thanks for inviting me, but I won't be able to make it this time.
notes: Turns down an invitation without sounding harsh.
contrast: I can't...より少し丁寧で柔らかい。

prompts.situation: You cannot join this invitation this time.
prompts.cloze: I won't be able to ___ it this time.

support.jaHint: 今回は参加できなさそうです

phrase: I'm tied up then, but I can do Monday.
japanese_meaning: その時間は埋まっていますが、月曜なら可能です
example: I'm tied up then, but I can do Monday afternoon.
notes: Pairs a no with a practical alternative.
contrast: 断るだけで終わらず次案を示せる。

prompts.situation: You cannot do that time, but you can offer another day.
prompts.cloze: I'm tied up then, but I can do ___.

support.jaHint: その時間は埋まっていますが、月曜なら可能です

phrase: From my perspective, this is the safest option.
japanese_meaning: 私の見方では、これが最も安全な選択です
example: From my perspective, this is the safest option for launch.
notes: Signals personal perspective in a professional tone.
contrast: I thinkよりややフォーマル。

prompts.situation: You want to share your view calmly in a meeting.
prompts.cloze: From my perspective, this is the safest ___.

support.jaHint: 私の見方では、これが最も安全な選択です

japanese_meaning: まだ完全には納得していません
